coverage_vs_windows.select_2023_09_18_to_2025_12_31: fully covered by SHY and all 10 crypto symbols (all listed well before 2023-09).
coverage_vs_windows.stress_2016_05_02_to_2023_09_15: BTC and ETH covered from 2016-05-02 (Coinbase backfill); LTC/BCH/LINK/DOGE/AVAX/UNI/AAVE/DOT covered only from their own Binance listing dates (later than 2016-05-02) -- reported per-candidate as 'stress sample short'/'stress period pending' in report.md, per the keep_rule.

data_gaps_confirmed.altcoin_stress_window_depth: LINK/UNI/AAVE/DOGE/AVAX/DOT/BCH/LTC each start on their own Binance USDT listing date (2019-2020 for most), later than the stress window's 2016-05-02 start. This is a known, reported limitation (see report.md 'stress sample short' labels for CRYPTO_DONCHIAN_TOP3 / CRYPTO_XS_TOP3_* / BTC_ETH_DUAL_MOM), not a blocking data gap -- those candidates are still evaluated on their available history.

crypto_session_prices.source: Binance public monthly klines (data.binance.vision, all 10 coins) + Coinbase Exchange public candles (api.exchange.coinbase.com, BTC/ETH backfill to 2016-05) -- both keyless.
crypto_session_prices.status: newly built this iteration -- the only new data download this round

known_caveats.session_alignment: Crypto trades 24/7; this iteration samples it only at the US equity session (09:30/16:00 ET on days data/sip/daily has an SPY bar) -- a deliberate scope choice (matches the rest of the screen_lane panel's calendar), not a data gap. No forward-fill: a session with no matching 15m bar is left NaN.
known_caveats.survivorship: Universe = coins Alpaca lists today; a coin delisted from Alpaca or from Binance mid-sample would still appear in the panel if it has Binance history, but the *selection* of which 10 coins to include is itself survivorship-biased (today's list, not a point-in-time list) -- noted in report.md, not corrected for.

notes: Crypto session prices are built locally this iteration by scripts/fetch_crypto_session_prices.py from Binance's public monthly-klines archive and (BTC/ETH only) a Coinbase Exchange public-candles backfill to 2016-05 -- no API keys, no broker credentials. Altcoin stress-window (pre-2023-09) coverage is limited to each coin's own Binance listing date; report.md labels any candidate whose stress-window sample is under 2 years 'stress sample short' or 'stress period pending' per the keep_rule above.
panel_source: SHY: data/sip/daily/<year>/*.parquet via screen_lane.load_batch_panel (unmodified). Crypto: data/research/crypto/session_prices.parquet via the batch module's extend_panel hook (screen_lane.apply_panel_extension, unmodified).

crypto_trend_screen.reason: SHY is present in the local SIP daily archive (data/sip/daily). All crypto prices (BTCUSD/ETHUSD/LTCUSD/BCHUSD/LINKUSD/DOGEUSD/AVAXUSD/UNIUSD/AAVEUSD/DOTUSD) come from data/research/crypto/session_prices.parquet, built this iteration by scripts/fetch_crypto_session_prices.py from Binance's public monthly-klines archive (all 10 coins) plus a Coinbase Exchange public-candles backfill to 2016-05 (BTC/ETH only) -- no API keys, no broker credentials, supplied to the screen_lane panel via extend_panel. No data gap blocks any of the 13 candidates from running; altcoin stress-window depth is limited to each coin's own Binance listing date and is reported per-candidate in report.md, not treated as a blocking gap.
